---
pagetitle: "`r sub('([A-Za-z]+)', '\\1 ', params$bill_num)`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    toc: false

params:
  bill_num: "HF856"
  ga: null  # General Assembly; null = CURRENT_GA
---

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(readr)

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)


library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/maps.R"))

ga <- resolve_ga(params$ga)

```


```{r}
bill <- read_json(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$bill_json, paste0(params$bill_num, ".json"))) |>
  pluck("bill")


people <- read_csv(ga_csv("people", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
bills_csv <- read_csv(ga_csv("bills", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)

sponsors <- bill |>
  pluck("sponsors") |>
  items_to_df()

history <- bill |>
  pluck("history") |>
  items_to_df()


# Votes lists more than just the committee vote for HF1
votes <- bill |>
  pluck("votes") |>
  items_to_df()

calendar <- bill |>
  pluck("calendar") |>
  items_to_df()

# Load processed vote summaries for party breakdown and classification
vote_summaries <- read_rds(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$votes, "summaries.rds"))
bill_vote_summaries <- vote_summaries |>
  filter(bill_id == bill$bill_id)

# Load bill groups (graceful degradation if not yet generated)
bill_groups_path <- file.path(ga_paths(ga)$bills, "groups.rds")
if (file.exists(bill_groups_path)) {
  bill_groups <- read_rds(bill_groups_path)
  bill_group_info <- bill_groups |> filter(bill == params$bill_num)
} else {
  bill_groups <- tibble(
    bill = character(),
    status = character(),
    group_status = character(),
    group_size = integer(),
    lead_bill = character(),
    group_members = list()
  )
  bill_group_info <- tibble(
    bill = params$bill_num,
    status = NA_character_,
    group_status = NA_character_,
    group_size = 1L,
    lead_bill = NA_character_,
    group_members = list(params$bill_num)
  )
}

# Load lobbyist declarations from pre-scraped data
lobby_path <- file.path(ga_paths(ga)$lobbying, "lobbyist_declarations.rds")
lobby <- if (file.exists(lobby_path)) {
  read_rds(lobby_path) |>
    filter(bill == params$bill_num, !is.na(client))
} else {
  NULL
}

lobby_for <- if (!is.null(lobby) && nrow(lobby) > 0) sum(lobby$most_recent_declaration == "For", na.rm = TRUE) else 0
lobby_against <- if (!is.null(lobby) && nrow(lobby) > 0) sum(lobby$most_recent_declaration == "Against", na.rm = TRUE) else 0
lobby_undecided <- if (!is.null(lobby) && nrow(lobby) > 0) sum(lobby$most_recent_declaration == "Undecided", na.rm = TRUE) else 0
```

```{r}
# --- Derived values for the redesigned header ---

# Cleaned serif title + boilerplate meta (Formerly / Effective)
clean_title <- clean_bill_title(bill$title)
formerly_txt <- str_match(bill$title, "\\(Formerly ([^)]+)\\.?\\)")[, 2]
effective_txt <- str_match(bill$title, "Effective date:\\s*([0-9/,\\s]+)\\.")[, 2]

# Red eyebrow: spelled-out bill type + number (e.g. "HOUSE FILE 856")
type_names <- c(HF = "House File", SF = "Senate File",
                HSB = "House Study Bill", SSB = "Senate Study Bill",
                HJR = "House Joint Resolution", SJR = "Senate Joint Resolution",
                HR = "House Resolution", SR = "Senate Resolution",
                HCR = "House Concurrent Resolution", SCR = "Senate Concurrent Resolution")
bill_prefix <- str_extract(params$bill_num, "^[A-Z]+")
bill_number_digits <- str_extract(params$bill_num, "\\d+")
type_label <- unname(type_names[bill_prefix])
if (is.na(type_label)) type_label <- bill_prefix
bill_eyebrow <- toupper(paste(type_label, bill_number_digits))

# Status (individual bill) drives the pill + stepper
bill_status <- if (nrow(bill_group_info) > 0 && !is.na(bill_group_info$status[1])) {
  bill_group_info$status[1]
} else {
  bills_row <- bills_csv |> filter(bill_number == params$bill_num)
  if (nrow(bills_row) > 0) bills_row$status_desc[1] else "Introduced"
}
# Steps depend on the bill type: resolutions end at "Adopted", joint
# resolutions at "Passed both chambers"
stepper_stages <- status_track(params$bill_num, bill_status)
stepper_reached <- sum(STATUS_LEVELS[stepper_stages] <= STATUS_LEVELS[bill_status])
if (is.na(stepper_reached)) stepper_reached <- 1L

# Primary sponsor display (committee-aware)
sponsor_display <- if (!is.null(sponsors) && nrow(sponsors) > 0) {
  is_committee <- is.na(sponsors$first_name[1]) || sponsors$first_name[1] == ""
  if (is_committee) {
    chamber <- if (sponsors$role[1] == "Sen") "Senate" else "House"
    paste(chamber, sponsors$name[1], "Committee")
  } else {
    sprintf("%s (%s-%s)", sponsors$name[1], sponsors$party[1], sponsors$district[1])
  }
} else {
  "—"
}

# Most recent action (history is chronological ascending in the JSON)
last_action_txt <- if (!is.null(history) && nrow(history) > 0) {
  la <- history |> arrange(desc(date)) |> slice(1)
  paste0(la$action, " — ", str_squish(format(as.Date(la$date), "%B %e, %Y")))
} else {
  "—"
}

# Related-bill table (for the "Related legislation" card)
related_df <- NULL
if (nrow(bill_group_info) > 0 && bill_group_info$group_size > 1) {
  related_bills_list <- unlist(bill_group_info$group_members)
  related_df <- bill_groups |>
    filter(bill %in% related_bills_list, bill != params$bill_num) |>
    left_join(bills_csv |> select(bill_number, title), by = c("bill" = "bill_number")) |>
    mutate(bill_link = format_bill_link(bill, "")) |>
    arrange(desc(status_level)) |>
    select(bill_link, title, status)
}
```

```{r}
# Bill header card: eyebrow + status pill, cleaned serif title, meta row, stepper
meta_row <- tagList(
  span(strong("Sponsor"), HTML("&nbsp;"), sponsor_display),
  if (!is.na(effective_txt)) span(strong("Effective"), HTML("&nbsp;"), str_squish(effective_txt)),
  if (!is.na(formerly_txt))  span(strong("Formerly"),  HTML("&nbsp;"), str_remove(str_squish(formerly_txt), "\\.$")),
  span(strong("Last action"), HTML("&nbsp;"), last_action_txt),
  span(strong("Full text"), HTML("&nbsp;"),
       a(href = bill$state_link, target = "_blank", "Iowa Legislature ↗"))
)

div(class = "ia-card",
  div(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow-row",
    span(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow", bill_eyebrow),
    status_pill(bill_status)
  ),
  h1(class = "ia-bill-title", clean_title$title),
  div(class = "ia-bill-meta", meta_row),
  ui_stepper(stepper_stages, stepper_reached)
)
```

## History
```{r}
fmt_date <- \(d) str_squish(format(if (is.character(d)) as.Date(d) else d, "%b %e, %Y"))
chamber_label <- \(x) case_when(x == "H" ~ "House", x == "S" ~ "Senate", .default = x)

ui_table(
  if (!is.null(history)) {
    history |> transmute(date = fmt_date(date), chamber = chamber_label(chamber), action)
  },
  labels = c(date = "Date", chamber = "Chamber", action = "Action"),
  nowrap = "date",
  empty = "No actions recorded yet."
)
```


## Votes
```{r}
#| results: "asis"

# Raw HTML into an asis chunk; the fence keeps pandoc from reading indented
# markup as a code block
cat_html <- function(x) cat("\n```{=html}\n", as.character(x), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

# Committee votes ("... Report") stay off the page; this tab is floor votes
floor_votes <- if (!is.null(votes)) votes |> filter(!str_detect(desc, "Report$"))

# One roll call's votes, joined to who cast them, in district order
read_roll_call <- function(roll_call_id) {
  read_json(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$vote_json, paste0(roll_call_id, ".json"))) |>
    pluck("roll_call", "votes") |>
    items_to_df() |>
    left_join(people |> select(people_id, name, party, district), by = "people_id") |>
    arrange(district)
}

# The question, then the result and how each party split, in words
roll_call_head <- function(vote_row, vote) {
  party_split <- function(p, label) {
    pv <- vote |> filter(party == p)
    if (nrow(pv) == 0) return(NULL)
    sprintf("%s %d yea, %d nay", label, sum(pv$vote_text == "Yea"), sum(pv$vote_text == "Nay"))
  }
  not_voting <- sum(!vote$vote_text %in% c("Yea", "Nay"))
  parts <- c(
    sprintf("%s %d to %d", if (vote_row$passed == 1) "Passed" else "Failed", vote_row$yea, vote_row$nay),
    party_split("D", "Democrats"),
    party_split("R", "Republicans"),
    if (not_voting > 0) sprintf("%d not voting", not_voting)
  )
  div(class = "ia-vote-head",
    div(class = "ia-card-title", vote_row$desc),
    div(class = "ia-card-sub", paste(parts, collapse = " · "))
  )
}

# Every member's vote, collapsed: the map above already shows the pattern
roll_call_table <- function(vote, chamber) {
  legislator_link <- function(id, nm) {
    if (is.na(nm)) return("Unknown")
    a(href = paste0("../../legislators/", get_legislator_filename(id, people), ".html"), nm)
  }
  tags$details(class = "ia-details",
    tags$summary(sprintf("How each %s voted (%d)",
                         if (chamber == "S") "senator" else "representative", nrow(vote))),
    ui_table(
      vote |> transmute(
        district = parse_district_number(district),
        legislator = map2(people_id, name, legislator_link),
        party = case_when(party == "D" ~ "Democrat", party == "R" ~ "Republican", .default = party),
        vote = map(vote_text, vote_pill)
      ),
      labels = c(district = "District", legislator = "Legislator", party = "Party", vote = "Vote"),
      numeric = "district"
    )
  )
}

vote_child_template <- c(
  "## `r tab_label`",
  "",
  "```{r}",
  "#| echo: false",
  "#| message: false",
  "#| warning: false",
  "roll_call_head(vote_row, vote)",
  "```",
  "",
  "```{r}",
  "#| echo: false",
  "#| message: false",
  "#| warning: false",
  "# Shared district geometry; this map embeds only colors and labels (maps.R)",
  "vote_map(vote, vote_row$chamber, ga)",
  "```",
  "",
  "```{r}",
  "#| echo: false",
  "#| message: false",
  "#| warning: false",
  "roll_call_table(vote, vote_row$chamber)",
  "```",
  ""
)

if (is.null(floor_votes) || nrow(floor_votes) == 0) {
  cat_html(ui_empty("No floor votes on this bill yet."))
} else {
  tally <- \(yea, nay) if_else(is.na(yea), NA_character_, paste0(yea, "–", nay))
  summary_tbl <- floor_votes |>
    left_join(
      bill_vote_summaries |>
        select(roll_call_id, vote_dem_yes, vote_dem_no, vote_gop_yes, vote_gop_no, vote_outcome),
      by = "roll_call_id"
    ) |>
    transmute(
      date = fmt_date(date),
      chamber = chamber_label(chamber),
      vote = simplify_vote_desc(desc),
      result = if_else(passed == 1, "Passed", "Failed"),
      yea, nay,
      # The Iowa journals record these together: "absent or not voting"
      not_voting = nv + absent,
      dem = tally(vote_dem_yes, vote_dem_no),
      gop = tally(vote_gop_yes, vote_gop_no),
      pattern = vote_outcome
    )

  cat("### Vote summaries\n\n")
  cat_html(tagList(
    ui_table(
      summary_tbl,
      labels = c(date = "Date", chamber = "Chamber", vote = "Vote", result = "Result",
                 yea = "Yea", nay = "Nay", not_voting = "Not voting",
                 dem = "Democrats", gop = "Republicans", pattern = "Pattern"),
      numeric = c("yea", "nay", "not_voting", "dem", "gop"),
      nowrap = c("date", "dem", "gop")
    ),
    div(class = "ia-footnote", "Party columns count yea–nay. Committee votes are not shown.")
  ))

  cat("### Individual votes\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(floor_votes)), function(i) {
    vote_row <- floor_votes[i, ]
    vote <- read_roll_call(vote_row$roll_call_id)
    tab_label <- paste(chamber_label(vote_row$chamber), simplify_vote_desc(vote_row$desc),
                       fmt_date(vote_row$date), sep = " · ")
    knitr::knit_child(text = vote_child_template, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
  })
  cat(unlist(res), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
```

if (is.null(lobby)) {
  ui_empty("Lobbyist declarations are unavailable right now.")
} else {

      arrange(most_recent_declaration, client) |>

## Calendar items
```{r}
# LegiScan gives 24-hour "15:00"; anything else passes through untouched
fmt_time <- \(t) if_else(str_detect(t, "^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}$"),
                         str_squish(format(strptime(t, "%H:%M"), "%l:%M %p")), t)

ui_table(
  if (!is.null(calendar)) {
    calendar |> transmute(date = fmt_date(date), time = fmt_time(time), type, description, location)
  },
  labels = c(date = "Date", time = "Time", type = "Type",
             description = "Description", location = "Location"),
  nowrap = c("date", "time"),
  empty = "No hearings or meetings scheduled for this bill."
)
```
